title: A fourth secret stays dormant until its keyword comes up
watchFor: For this run Brask holds four secrets, one more than the sheet shows (`codex.activeSecrets` 3). With nothing active, the last of them, his sister's pirate radio station, is dormant: off the director's sheet in scenes 1 and 2 (across a save and reload and a day), so it can't be kept or hinted at. In scene 3 Rook asks about the radio, which is its keyword: the cue should come back (the lore section shows it), Brask's tell (turning the radio down) may show, and whether he tells is up to his gates. Full text still depends on the expansion budget (acceptance 9).

brask.text: He's three months behind on the workshop rent and Pim has been letting it slide; he's afraid one day she won't.
brask.summary: Three months behind on the workshop rent.
brask.tell: Counts his coins twice before paying for anything

brask.text: He can't swim, and he's the one everybody calls when the lower level floods.
brask.summary: Can't swim, though everyone calls him for floods.
brask.tell: Stays two steps above the waterline and calls it caution

brask.text: The radio in his workshop is tuned to the pirate station his sister runs from the Seep; if the Saints traced it, she'd be in real trouble.
brask.summary: His sister runs a pirate radio station from the Seep.
brask.tell: Turns the radio down whenever someone asks what's playing

turns: "Dunmar says the pumps held last night. Your doing, Brask?"
"Vex, you look like you could sleep for a week."
"Brask, what's that station you always have on the radio in the workshop?"
"Who runs it? The voice sounds a bit like you."
